title: Terminal link counter exhaustion leaves duplicate tuple frame queued
description: Post-fix correctness review: send checks tuple exhaustion only in _next_seqnum after signing and queue push. After (0xff,0xffff) is used, the next send raises but leaves a duplicate terminal-counter frame queued for later drain. Preflight exhaustion before all mutation; failed send leaves queue/reservation/stats unchanged and later drain cannot transmit a duplicate. Add exact terminal-boundary assertions.
